sections.text: On iPhone: Open the Health app and tap the Summary tab. Tap your profile picture in the upper corner. Under your profile picture, tap 'Medical ID'. Turn on 'Show When Locked' to make Medical ID available from the Lock screen. Tap 'Edit' or 'Add' next to a field to update it. You can add medications, allergies, and conditions. Tap 'Done'.

On iPhone: To share your Medical ID with emergency responders, turn on 'Share During Emergency Call'. Medical ID is then shared automatically when you call or text emergency services from iPhone or Apple Watch. If you turn off 'Emergency Calls & SOS', your Medical ID information will not be shared. This is set under Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services > System Services.

On Android: Open the Safety app and sign in to your Google Account. Tap 'Your info'. Tap 'Medical information', then tap an item such as blood type, allergies, or medications to update it. For contacts, tap 'Emergency contacts' and then 'Add contact'. Choose the existing contact you want to add. To show your emergency information when your screen is locked, tap 'Emergency info access' and then 'Show when locked'.

I already added my blood type under Medical information and turned on Show when locked for my emergency contact. Next, how does a paramedic see it when my phone is locked?

sections.text: On Android: On a locked screen, swipe up. Tap 'Emergency' and then 'View emergency info'. To share with emergency services, open the Personal Safety app, tap 'Your info', then 'Emergency Info access', and then 'Share during emergency call'. Anyone who picks up your phone can find your lock screen message and emergency information even if your phone is locked. You can turn this setting off in the Safety app.

On Android: Open the Safety app and sign in to your Google Account. Tap 'Your info'. Tap 'Medical information', then tap an item such as blood type, allergies, or medications to update it. For contacts, tap 'Emergency contacts' and then 'Add contact'. Choose the existing contact you want to add. To show your emergency information when your screen is locked, tap 'Emergency info access' and then 'Show when locked'.
